security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Privacy-first local photo intelligence and organization
bundle.longDescription: PhotoGremlin is a local-first desktop application that indexes your photo folders on your own machine: scanning, thumbnails, EXIF extraction, image analysis, quality filtering, similarity grouping, saved views and collections. Optional local face detection runs on-device. Photos never leave your computer, and the app makes no network requests at runtime.
